_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
padres: Spring training opens in Peoria in February and the regular season in late March at Petco Park; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
sdfc: San Diego FC's MLS season runs late February to October at Snapdragon Stadium, 17 home matches, with the Cup playoffs through early December.
wave: The Wave's NWSL season runs March to November at Snapdragon Stadium, with the playoffs beyond that; the fixture list arrives over the winter.
aztecs: Aztecs football runs late August to November at Snapdragon Stadium, six or seven home Saturdays, in the Pac-12 since 2026, with the conference championship and a bowl beyond that.
aztecsmbb: Aztecs basketball runs early November to March at Viejas Arena, in the Pac-12 since 2026, with the conference tournament in Las Vegas and the NCAA tournament beyond that; the non-conference slate fills in over the summer.
gulls: The Gulls' AHL season runs October to April at Pechanga Arena, 36 home dates, with the Calder Cup playoffs beyond that.
